secoes.corpo:
Based on SINBAD criteria with positive scoring.

Processing clinical reasoning...

The NANDA diagnosis requires careful evaluation of its taxonomies, searching for characteristics and relationships. The disclosure of diagnoses on this scale has only the educational purpose of promoting their use and understanding its various diagnoses. Under no circumstances should it induce the user to indiscriminately use any nursing diagnosis without support from clinical findings obtained through anamnesis, physical examination, and other systematic tools that will lead the nurse to prescribe care.

Based on SINBAD criteria with positive scoring.

Processing clinical reasoning...

The NANDA diagnosis requires careful evaluation of its taxonomies, searching for characteristics and relationships. The disclosure of diagnoses on this scale has only the educational purpose of promoting their use and understanding its various diagnoses. Under no circumstances should it induce the user to indiscriminately use any nursing diagnosis without support from clinical findings obtained through anamnesis, physical examination, and other systematic tools that will lead the nurse to prescribe care.

Scientific Reference
INCE, P. et al. Use of the SINBAD classification system and score in comparing outcome of foot ulcer management on three continents . Diabetes Care, v. 31, n. 5, p. 964-967, 2008. DOI: 10.2337/dc07-2367 .

Interpretation of the SINBAD Score

Low Risk (0 - 1)
Good healing prognosis. Standard wound care.

Moderate Risk (2 - 3)
Increased risk of amputation. Intensify care and monitoring.

High Risk (4 - 6)
High risk of amputation. Urgent multidisciplinary intervention.

Reference: Ince et al. (2008) — Diabetes Care
